[Surface] Brave Answers Deep Research

Part of [`seek research`](seek-research.md).

## Usage

```text
seek research brave [options] <query...>
```

## Arguments

| Argument | Required | Description | Default |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `query...` | Yes, one or more | Research question |  |

## Options

| Option | Description | Default |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--country <cc>` | Two-letter country code for grounding (default: us) |  |
| `--language <code>` | Response language (default: en) |  |
| `--citations` | Request provider citation tags | `false` |
| `--entities` | Request provider entity tags | `false` |
| `--json` | Emit JSON (raw response for synchronous research) |  |
| `-h, --help` | display help for command |  |

## Help

The output of `seek research brave --help`:

```text
Usage: seek research brave [options] <query...>

[Surface] Brave Answers Deep Research

Arguments:
  query              Research question

Options:
  --country <cc>     Two-letter country code for grounding (default: us)
  --language <code>  Response language (default: en)
  --citations        Request provider citation tags (default: false)
  --entities         Request provider entity tags (default: false)
  --json             Emit JSON (raw response for synchronous research)
  -h, --help         display help for command

Brave research is synchronous because its streaming endpoint does not expose a resumable job. --async is not supported.
```
